mapper.select: SELECT * FROM repair_purchase_orders WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM repair_purchase_orders WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND status!='CANCELLED'
SELECT * FROM repair_purchase_orders WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_purchase_orders SET status=#{status},order_number=#{orderNumber},supplier=#{supplier},ordered_at=#{orderedAt},currency=#{currency},adjustment_amount=#{adjustmentAmount},confirmed_total=#{confirmedTotal},received_at=#{receivedAt},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM repair_purchase_items WHERE purchase_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM repair_purchase_items WHERE purchase_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,purpose,name,brand,model,quantity,received_quantity FROM repair_purchase_items WHERE purchase_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_purchase_items SET purpose=#{purpose},name=#{name},brand=#{brand},model=#{model},quantity=#{quantity},unit_price=#{unitPrice},spec_confirmed=#{specConfirmed},spec_confirmed_by=#{specConfirmedBy},spec_confirmed_at=#{specConfirmedAt},source_ocr_job_id=#{sourceOcrJobId},source_candidate_index=#{sourceCandidateIndex} WHERE id=#{id} AND purchase_order_id=#{purchaseOrderId} AND received_quantity=0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM repair_purchase_items WHERE id=#{id} AND received_quantity=0
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_purchase_items SET received_quantity=received_quantity+#{quantity} WHERE id=#{id} AND purchase_order_id=#{orderId} AND received_quantity+#{quantity}<=quantity
UPDATE repair_material_receipts SET event_id=#{eventId} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.*,m.display_name AS receiver_name FROM repair_material_receipts r JOIN repair_members m ON m.user_id=r.receiver_id WHERE r.purchase_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY r.received_at DESC,r.id DESC
SELECT l.purchase_item_id,i.name,l.quantity FROM repair_material_receipt_items l JOIN repair_purchase_items i ON i.id=l.purchase_item_id WHERE l.receipt_id=#{receiptId} ORDER BY l.purchase_item_id
SELECT * FROM repair_cost_confirmations WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_cost_confirmations SET labor_amount=#{laborAmount},other_amount=#{otherAmount},note=#{note},confirmed_by=#{confirmedBy},confirmed_at=#{confirmedAt},version=version+1 WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND version=#{version}
